english.note: Use this conversationally when the next action follows naturally from the situation or what was just said.
Use this conversationally when the consequence follows immediately from the situation or what was just said.
Use this in a conditional result meaning “in that case, then,” usually before the consequence.

examples.english: You said you wanted to eat, so accordingly let’s go now.
examples.traditional: 你話想食飯，咁就而家去啦。
examples.jyutping: nei5 waa6 soeng2 sik6 faan6 gam2 zau6 ji4 gaa1 heoi3 laa1

examples.english: You do not eat breakfast, therefore you will get hungry.
examples.traditional: 你唔食早餐，咁就會肚餓。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 sik6 zou2 caan1 gam2 zau6 wui5 tou5 ngo6

examples.english: If you don't want to go, then stay home.
examples.traditional: 你唔想去，咁就留喺屋企啦。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 gam2 zau6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 laa1
